in_hebrew.name: חריסטי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'Christos' meaning 'anointed' or 'beloved'. In Hebrew, this name is translated as 'Charis' meaning 'grace' and 'Tov' meaning 'good'.

in_greek.name: Χριστή
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Christos', meaning 'anointed' or 'chosen one'. In the New Testament, the name 'Christos' is translated as 'Jesus'.

in_latin.name: Christiana
in_latin.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'Christianus', meaning 'follower of Christ'. In this case, the feminine form is 'Christiana'.
